the accident pilots did not perform the accident approach as they were trained

chain.label: Descent rate increased rapidly to about 2,000 fpm

caused_by.evidence: Because the airplane was high on the approach, it was out of position to use a normal descent rate of 1,000 feet per minute (fpm) to the MDA

chain.label: At the MDA, with the approach unstabilized, captain did not call a missed approach and let the descent continue without the runway environment in sight

caused_by.evidence: the airspeed was 11 knots below the minimum required airspeed of 124 knots, and the airplane was improperly configured with 45° flaps...The captain should have determined that the approach was unstabilized and initiated a missed approach, but he did not do so

chain.label: First officer failed to manage pitch and thrust to counter flaps-45 drag while attempting to level off
